name: form-action
whatItDemonstrates: Submitting a Form through a React Server Function via the `action` prop with `useActionState`, surfacing server-side validation errors on the matching field while the submission is pending.
stateManaged: controlled — the `errors` prop is driven by `React.useActionState` state (`state.serverErrors`); the input itself is uncontrolled (`defaultValue`), and useActionState's `loading` flag gates the submit Button's `disabled`.
nonTrivialInteractions: Submission bypasses `onSubmit` entirely: `Form action={formAction}` wires React's action flow, and the server function receives native `FormData`

Fake server action (1s delay) returns errors keyed by field name ('admin' reserved, random 50% 'unavailable', catch-all server error), which render via `Field.Error` by matching `Field.Root name="username"`
Submit Button is disabled but `focusableWhenDisabled` while the action is pending (`loading` from useActionState)

name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A Form whose `onSubmit` handler validates a URL against a fake async server and feeds the server error back into the `errors` prop to render on the field.
stateManaged: controlled — the `errors` prop is driven by `useState({})` (`setErrors` after the async response); a separate `useState(false)` loading flag gates the submit Button's `disabled`; the input itself is uncontrolled (`defaultValue`).
nonTrivialInteractions: `onSubmit` calls `event.preventDefault()` itself and extracts the field value with `new FormData(event.currentTarget)`
Native constraint validation (`required` plus `pattern="https?://.*"` on a `type="url"` control) gates submission before the async handler runs
Fake server (1s delay) returns an error string ('example domain not allowed' or invalid URL) mapped into `errors: { url: ... }` so `Field.Error` picks it up by name
Submit Button is disabled but `focusableWhenDisabled` during the async pending state

name: zod
whatItDemonstrates: Schema-validating form values with Zod inside `onFormSubmit` and mapping `z.flattenError(...).fieldErrors` back through the `errors` prop so each `Field.Error` renders its own message.
stateManaged: controlled — the `errors` prop is driven by `useState({})` (`setErrors` from the Zod `safeParse` result); both inputs are uncontrolled (no value/defaultValue).
nonTrivialInteractions: `onFormSubmit` receives `formValues` as a plain JavaScript object (no FormData extraction), keyed by `Field.Root name`
Zod schema (`name` min-length, `age` coerced to a positive number) is parsed with `schema.safeParse()` and errors flattened via `z.flattenError(result.error).fieldErrors`
Flattened fieldErrors are keyed to match `Field.Root name="name"` / `name="age"`, so each `Field.Error` displays only its own validation message
Successful parse resets `errors` to `{}`, clearing all field errors
